previous_assumption: Passing concrete repository classes (UserRepository, MembershipRepository, RoleRepository, OrganizationRepository, SessionRepository) directly as AuthService/PermissionService constructor dependencies is an acceptable first-pass simplification.
correction: The approved architecture contract explicitly requires repository INTERFACES as the application layer's dependency, not concrete classes ('Repositories are interfaces from the application/domain perspective'). Refactored every module to a domain/ports.ts interface that the concrete Kysely-backed class implements, so application services (auth-service.ts, permission-service.ts) never import Kysely types at all — verified by grep, zero Kysely imports outside */infrastructure/.
